subQuestions.questionText: Complete the statement by choosing the option in COLUMN B: 'Settlements are classified as rural, based on …' (Y: the number of functions / Z: the total population)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (the number of functions) (1 mark)
Settlements are classified as rural based on the number of functions they perform; rural settlements perform relatively few functions.

subQuestions.questionText: Complete the statement by choosing the option in COLUMN B: 'The actual physical position where a rural settlement is located …' (Y: site / Z: situation)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (site) (1 mark)
Site refers to the actual physical position or ground on which a rural settlement is located, whereas situation refers to its position relative to the surrounding area.

subQuestions.questionText: Complete the statement by choosing the option in COLUMN B: 'A loose grouping of farmsteads is called a …' (Y: town / Z: hamlet)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Z (hamlet) (1 mark)
A hamlet is a small, loose grouping of a few farmsteads.

subQuestions.questionText: Complete the statement by choosing the option in COLUMN B: 'A … has mostly rural functions and some urban functions.' (Y: farmstead / Z: village)
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Z (village) (1 mark)
A village has mostly rural functions together with some urban functions.

subQuestions.questionText: The pattern of the settlement shown in the sketch below is … (Y: nucleated / Z: dispersed). Refer to the sketch (KEY: settlement, road; scale 1 : 30 000).
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Z (dispersed) (1 mark)
The sketch shows farmsteads spread far apart from one another, which is the defining feature of a dispersed settlement pattern.

subQuestions.questionText: The sketch below depicts a … settlement (Y: wet-point / Z: dry-point). Refer to the sketch (KEY: river, settlement, contour line).
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (wet-point) (1 mark)
The sketch shows the settlement located next to a river, which is a wet-point settlement (located where water is readily available).

subQuestions.questionText: The shape of the settlement shown in the sketch below is … (Y: linear / Z: round). Refer to the sketch (KEY: river, settlement).
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: Y (linear) (1 mark)
The settlement is arranged in a line along the river, which is a linear settlement shape.

subQuestions.questionText: A … trade and transport town/city is shown in the photograph below.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: C (break-of-bulk-point) (1 mark)
A break-of-bulk-point trade and transport town/city develops where goods are transferred from one mode of transport to another.

subQuestions.questionText: Plettenberg Bay in the photograph below is classified as a/an … urban settlement and its dominant economic function is … (i) gateway (ii) specialised (iii) tourism (iv) mining
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: C ((ii) and (iii)) (1 mark)
Plettenberg Bay is classified as a specialised urban settlement (ii) and its dominant economic function is tourism (iii).

subQuestions.questionText: A … provides mostly low-order goods and services to the surrounding rural population.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: D (town) (1 mark)
A town provides mostly low-order goods and services to the surrounding rural population.

subQuestions.questionText: … is the maximum distance that people will travel to buy goods or obtain services.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: B (Range) (1 mark)
The range is the maximum distance that people will travel to buy goods or obtain a service.

subQuestions.questionText: … refers to the uncontrolled growth of urban areas.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: C (Urban sprawl) (1 mark)
Urban sprawl refers to the uncontrolled outward growth of urban areas.

subQuestions.questionText: The cartoon below depicts the negative impact of … (KEY: building, tree).
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: D (urban expansion) (1 mark)
The cartoon depicts the negative impact of urban expansion (the encroachment of buildings onto trees/green space).

subQuestions.questionText: … is a process whereby an increasing percentage of a country's population lives in urban rather than rural areas.
subQuestions.memoText:
Correct answer: A (Urbanisation) (1 mark)
Urbanisation is the process whereby an increasing percentage of a country's population lives in urban rather than rural areas.

subQuestions.questionText: Calculate the area of the demarcated feature 6 in blocks B4, C3 and C4 in m². Use the following information: Measured breadth (orthophoto map distance) = 1,8 cm. Formula: Area = Length (L) x Breadth (B). (Refer to the orthophoto map; measure the length.)
